summary: The Catalog Community Sync notes for 20 May 2026 are an agenda with links and record no outcomes. Items carried over from the previous sync were the REST spec change to pass signer properties from server to client, Auth Manager v2 (a configuration pull request and an all-in-one pull request), URL versus form encoding in the Java clients, and the storage credential refresh design, with a request to review the S3 prototype before the broader implementation continues. The one new topic was encryption support in the REST catalog, specifically credentials for the KMS.
